title: Menu: Paged menu with nested submenus (daisyUI)
notes:
Menu is used to display a list of links vertically or horizontally.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/menu/+page.md
